subject: 3 Heart Run
text: The 3 Heart run limits the player to a maximum of 3 hearts, so Heart Containers cannot be collected.

evidence.quote: It means you can only have a maximum of 3 hearts. Meaning no collecting Heart Containers.

subject: RA set
text: The achievement set is based on the Ocarina of Time (U) (V1.0) [!] ROM.

evidence.quote: The set is complete and based on Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time (U) (V1.0) [!]

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu dungeon item
text: The Inside Jabu-Jabu dungeon item cannot be obtained without a glitch, even though backtracking is possible.

evidence.quote: You can backtrack, but one dungeon item (Inside Jabu-Jabu) cannot be obtained without a glitch.

subject: Heart collection requirements
text: A commenter notes that some achievements require no heart collection while one requires collecting them all.

evidence.quote: So, some require no heart collection whereas one requires collecting them all?

subject: Achievement playthroughs
text: Some achievements may require more than one playthrough, according to a commenter.

evidence.quote: More than one playthrough required, then

subject: Emulator memory
text: A commenter says a 4GB memory expander is needed because 32-bit apps handle memory as-is.

evidence.quote: You need to use a 4GB memory expander because 32-bit apps handle it as-is.

subject: OOT community retexture
text: A commenter says the OOT community retexture takes too long to load and that a crash forces the player to wait again.

evidence.quote: I tried OOT community retexture but it take too long to load and if for some reason the game crush you have to wait again unless there is a faster way to load textures or patch the rom with textures.

subject: Boss achievements
text: A commenter says a couple of the boss achievements need a good understanding of game mechanics and a quick web search.

evidence.quote: a couple of the boss ones just requires a decent understanding of the game mechanics and a quick google search should help out enough for that

subject: 3 Heart Challenge
text: A commenter says the 3 Heart Challenge is not difficult if the player knows the game mechanics.

evidence.quote: The 3 Heart Challenge is not difficult if the player knows the game mechanics.

subject: 3 Heart run enemies
text: In the 3 Heart run, only Stalfos and Iron Knuckles should cause trouble, if bottled fairies and bombs are not used.

evidence.quote: The only enemies that should give players issues during the run would be Stalfos and Iron Knuckles. ... And that is if they do not use bottled fairies or bombs.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: A commenter reset the emulator before Phantom Ganon after already having all 30 arrows.

evidence.quote: in the case of Phantom Ganon, I just reset that I already had all 30 arrows

subject: Fatal error crash
text: A commenter says a fatal error crash can be fixed by using a different video plugin.

evidence.quote: Try using a different video plugin.

subject: Wrong ROM
text: Loading the wrong ROM brings the player to an entry that says which version to use.

evidence.quote: when you load the wrong rom, it should bring you to this entry, which tells you which version to use.

subject: RA set
text: A commenter says to use the 1.0 U ROM for the achievements.

evidence.quote: @Kayrod, make sure you're using 1.0 U rom.

subject: 3 Heart run requirement
text: Achievements marked with 3 hearts in parentheses require a 3 Heart run, according to a commenter.

evidence.quote: Wait, is a 3 Heart run required for the ones that say 3 hearts in ()? ... yes it does.

subject: Jabu-Jabu map
text: Skipping maps and compasses before learning of the 3 Heart requirement locked a player out of the Jabu Jabu map.

evidence.quote: I was avoiding the maps & compasses before I knew that achievement could only be done in a 3 heart run and I started going back to get the ones I skipped over and I'm locked out of the Jabu Jabu map.

subject: Cartographer
text: The Cartographer achievement requires all maps, compasses and keys from every dungeon.

evidence.quote: all maps, compasses AND keys from every dungeon.

subject: Jabu-Jabu map room
text: To enter the Jabu-Jabu map room, target the monster just outside, press C up as you land on the switch, and the door opens while the switch stays unpressed.

evidence.quote: Target the monster just outside the map room, then press C up just as you land on the switch. The door will open, but the switch will stay unpressed, but you can still enter the room.

subject: Jabu Jabu map
text: A commenter says the Jabu Jabu map can be obtained using a little glitch.

evidence.quote: not necessarily, you could grab the jabu jabu map using a little glitch.

subject: Accomplished Angler
text: The Hylian Loach achievement can only be earned in the fishing pond if the player fishes as an adult first.

evidence.quote: Oh yeah, you can ONLY get the achievement in the fishing pond for catching the Hylian Loach if you fish as an adult first.

subject: Fishing achievements
text: A commenter corrects that fishing as an adult first stops three fishing achievements from unlocking.

evidence.quote: No. Sorry, I was upset at the time and couldn't think clearly. If you fish as an ADULT first, the three won't unlock.

subject: Mischievous Hero
text: Stealing the pond owner's hat, saving, and resetting with it does not earn the achievement.

evidence.quote: Apparently, it's not possible to steal his hat, save, then reset with it and still get the achievement.

subject: Lifestyle and Stones
text: Clicking off the game screen, attacking the stone with a sword, saving, or unequipping from the C button may stop Lifestyle and Stones from unlocking.

evidence.quote: 32 Stones: The only way I could be missing this is because I clicked off the game screen, attacked it with a sword, saved, or took it off the c button, which I think I already checked.

subject: Jabu-Jabu map room glitch
text: A commenter links a YouTube video and says to mimic it to glitch into the Jabu Jabu map room.

evidence.quote: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B3L8ZE_bWCM try to mimic what's done in this video, it shouldn't be too tough.

subject: Race Against the Clock
text: The Barinade speed run timer keeps running until Barinade explodes.

evidence.quote: The timer is at 50 seconds by the time the boss fight starts and I killed him before the 3:41 mark but the timer doesn't stop until he explodes so it screws you over.

subject: Barinade load time
text: Saving after the battle loads cuts the time to 21 seconds to load.

evidence.quote: Save after the battle loads and it'll cut the time to 21 seconds to load.

subject: Barinade third phase
text: Deku Nuts clear the spinning objects around Barinade in his third phase, which is the easiest phase to mess up.

evidence.quote: I was able to get it after finding out that deku nuts get rid of those things that surround him in the 3rd phase where they spin very fast. ... That phase is the easiest to mess up on.

subject: Completion achievements
text: Achievements that say to complete the game only trigger after the game is beaten, including Ganon.

evidence.quote: The achievement didn't pop but I'm guessing since it says complete the game so we have to beat it to get it so I'll have to fight Ganon again.

subject: Europe ROM

evidence.quote: No "Europe" Version is working with the RAProject64 emulator.

subject: RA set
text: The set is based on the Ocarina of Time (U) (V1.0) [!] ROM with MD5 5bd1fe107bf8106b2ab6650abecd54d6.

evidence.quote: Actually is based on 5bd1fe107bf8106b2ab6650abecd54d6 Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time (U) (V1.0) [!].

subject: Other ROM versions
text: Using a different ROM than the set is based on may cause achievements to trigger randomly or not at all, and 1.1 and 1.2 versions are incompatible.

evidence.quote: You might have issues with some achievements like triggering at random times or not triggering at all if you use a different rom than the one its based. ... Also 1.1 and 1.2 versions are incompatible since they store data at completly different addresses
